hero.h1: Hydro Jetting in Lincoln Park, Chicago
hero.sub: When several kitchens and bathrooms share one old drain line, buildup comes back fast. Hydro jetting scours the pipe walls clean. We camera the line first and give you a flat price. Our office is on Diversey Parkway.

img.alt: J. Blanton Plumbing technician kneeling on a residential driveway, feeding a hydro jet hose into a sewer cleanout, with a branded service truck parked at the curb behind him

trust: 4.7 stars · 5,669+ Google reviews across all locations

blocks.body: Hydro jetting clears a sewer line with a high-pressure water stream, fed through the same cleanout access point used for rodding. A specialized nozzle sprays water in every direction as it moves through the pipe, scouring grease, scale, and roots off the entire pipe wall instead of just cutting a path through the middle. It's the fix for buildup that keeps coming back after rodding, or for roots that have worked into the pipe joints. Rodding opens the line back up. Hydro jetting cleans it.

img.alt: Diagram showing how hydro jetting clears a residential sewer line, with a cross-section view of the underground pipe, jet nozzle, high-pressure water spray, and debris being flushed toward the street connection

blocks.h2: Jetting Kitchen Stacks in Multi-Unit Buildings
blocks.body: In a building with stacked kitchens, grease from every unit runs down the same vertical pipe and into one horizontal line in the basement. That line is where grease cools, settles and builds up. Rodding opens it for a while, but the buildup stays. Jetting from a basement cleanout scours the line clean, and in many buildings we can also jet the stack from above to clear buildup higher up.

blocks.h2: Hydro Jetting Questions From Lincoln Park Homeowners

items.q: Can hydro jetting clean a building's main stack?
items.answer: Often. Cast iron stacks with heavy scale can be jetted from an accessible cleanout. We check the pipe first.

items.preview: If it's sound. We check first.
items.answer: If the camera shows the pipe is sound, yes. Broken sections get repaired first.

items.q: How is jetting different from rodding?
items.preview: It cleans the whole wall, not just a path.
items.answer: Rodding cuts a path through a clog. Jetting removes grease, scale and roots from the entire pipe wall.

items.q: How long do the results last?
items.preview: Years for grease, less for roots.
items.answer: Often years for grease and scale. Roots grow back eventually through open joints.

items.q: How often should a building's kitchen line be jetted?
items.answer: Often every year or two in buildings with stacked kitchens. The camera tells us.

items.q: How much does hydro jetting cost in Lincoln Park?
items.preview: It depends on the line and buildup. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the line length, access and how much buildup there is. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
